environment.description: ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) with container definition specifying readonlyRootFilesystem:true in the task definition containerDefinitions block. No additional volume mounts, no EFS volumes, no bind mounts configured. The Fargate platform enforces the overlay filesystem as read-only at the containerd/snapshotter level - the container process receives EROFS (errno 30) on any write syscall targeting the root filesystem including /opt, /tmp, /var, /home, and all other paths. No tmpfs mounts are injected (unlike standard Kubernetes which auto-mounts a writable /tmp). The task networking uses awsvpc mode with security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e restricting egress to the SQS VPC endpoint only.
